name: Dornburg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow with the upper part counterchanged, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Dornburg (a red lion and a wavy bar).
history: Municipal flag of Dornburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Dornburg arms — lion and wavy bar
